result:
I've finished T-DG4-FE-G2B and written the handback. All five scope items are delivered, but two acceptance checks are not fully green: one integration test fails in full runs, and I didn't re-run the full e2e suite after my last fix.

**Acceptance results**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG3` | exit 0, PASS |
| typecheck, build, lint, prettier, openapi lint | all exit 0; lint, typecheck and prettier re-run at the end, still 0 |
| unit tests, locale unset and `C.UTF-8` | exit 0 both: 2691 passed; 259 passed, 2 skipped |
| integration | **exit 1 in both full runs**: 1779 passed, 1 failed |
| full product e2e | **exit 1**: 307 passed, 1 failed, 2 did not run; after a fix, the affected specs re-ran 30/30 |

- **Integration failure:** the same worker test, `apps/worker/test/integration/benefits-queue.test.ts`, times out in both full runs and passes when run alone (2/2). This task changes no file under `apps/api`, `apps/worker` or `packages`. I didn't run the suite on the base commit `983fdfa`, so I can't say whether the base fails the same way or whether load or test order is the cause. Someone needs to check it on the base tree. I didn't touch the test or its timeout.
- **e2e failure:** `[chromium-ar] journeys.spec.ts`, "administration screens", failed. That test expects "Synthetic Transformation Lead" on page 1 of the users list, which is sorted by name. My spec's new user "Synthetic Sponsor en" sorted before it and pushed it to page 2. I renamed my user to "Synthetic Waiver Sponsor trace" so it sorts after the Lead, and `journeys.spec.ts` plus my spec then passed 30/30. That targeted re-run can't recreate the full suite's set of users, though, and the full 41-minute suite didn't fit in the time limit, so it hasn't been run since the fix.

**Salvage of the WIP commit**
- **Kept:** I reviewed every screen, the API layer (every request path checked against `openapi.yaml`), the translations, the append-only shared-file edits and the tests.
- **Changed:**
  - The G1/G2 gate label rendered "Inherited — Inherited - recorded, not granted in platform", which I found by looking at the screenshot. It now shows the label once, and the tests check the full text instead of the bare word "Inherited".
  - The workstream code column now sorts WS-09 before WS-10.
  - Editing a trace link no longer sends a share that hasn't changed ("0.6" against the stored "0.600000").
- **Added:** an e2e step that records and accepts a Modular-links waiver and checks that the screen shows it in force while both blocking links stay listed. The WIP was missing this.

The new spec passes in both languages with 0 serious or critical axe issues and checks all five new screens at 390 px and 200 % text. I added no `problems.json` keys and routed no operations; my web task has no pending list.

**For the orchestrator**
- **Contract need:** the missing-links response doesn't say whether a waiver is in force, so the screen works it out from the dispensations list using today's date in the transformation's time zone. The server uses its own business-date clock, so the two can disagree on the expiry day. I suggest adding an optional waiver field to that response.
- **D-113:** the assignment cites it, but it isn't in this tree's `decisions.md`. I followed the assignment's own text.

All changes are uncommitted. The run took about 109 minutes (09:40Z to 11:29Z).

Files are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG4/`:
- T-DG4-FE-G2-frontend-ux-engineer.md
- T-DG4-FE-G2-evidence/ (logs, plus 27 screenshots per language under `screenshots/en` and `screenshots/ar`)
